Work only inside the paths your order owns. Done means `just work-check <id>`
passes; say what changed in one line at the end.

## You may

- edit the order's owned paths
- run tac check and the order's criteria
- write proposals and journals to the worker store

## You may never

- push
- touch .agents/
- write approvals or receipts
- edit another order's files
- commit on Codex
